change: Bind each credit's independently hashed intake qualification and enforce its maximum reprojection error, capped at two integer gray levels. Independently rounding the raw image at two resolutions can produce a two-level difference on rare individual pixels.
trigger: The initial learner-side assumption of a one-level maximum rejected the fifth source before any model fit. The original intake had already qualified a two-level maximum. This correction verifies the same image indices and provenance as that intake.
